why i love a home cooked Indian lunch? 
A typical Indian lunch in my home often centers around a wholesome plate featuring steamed rice, dal, and subzi. The steamed rice forms the heart of the meal providing the perfect backdrop for the other dishes. The dal, simmered to perfection with a bunch of spices, offers a comforting and protein-rich base, while the subzi cooked in an array of spices and herbs, adds both nutrition and a tantalizing complexity of tastes. Paired with a bowl of dahi and some fresh cut vegetables, you have yourself the perfect and filling meal!
